description: Fault injection over plan_popitem_fix's fixtures (context_from): the harness deterministically rejects the first submit_plan with a generic could-not-verify reason. Grades recovery: after one rejection the model must promptly resubmit a complete, valid, correctly-shaped plan instead of degrading. The plan-side degradation to watch for is not an empty artifact (empty steps reject) but a placeholder step — a label-only plan verifies today — which fix_kinds_one_of rules out. Injected reason stays generic for the same measured reason as the review side: false specifics gaslight the model into breaking a valid artifact.
